CheckItem.description: One line of a concept or view check.

id.description: e.g. part.keyring_loop, text, ask.1, markings, no_extra_base
id.title: Id

label.description: What must be true, e.g. Name reads Bronco
label.title: Label

on.description: figure: the figure-only image; product: the product concept; view: s04
on.title: On

CheckItem.title: CheckItem

ConceptCandidate.description:
One concept. `image` is the product concept the customer approves (the figure with the
plate and name, the loop, or the base; the charm for a flat form). `figure_image` is the
figure alone: the 3D input for a figure-form job and the source of a flat charm.

meshy_task_id.description: The figure render task: tweaks chain from it, and s04 and s05 build a figure-form job from it
meshy_task_id.title: Meshy Task Id

figure_image.description: None on jobs from before the split: the figure is `image`
figure_image.title: Figure Image

product_task_id.description: Task that drew the product: the add-on edit (figure form) or the Creative Lab prototype that s05 builds (flat form)
product_task_id.title: Product Task Id

product_source.description: figure: no visible add-on, the product is the figure; edit: an image edit added the add-ons and the figure pixels were pasted back; code: add-ons drawn in code; prototype: a Creative Lab charm with the loop drawn in code
product_source.title: Product Source

ConceptCandidate.title: ConceptCandidate

ConceptCheck.description:
Claude vision check of one candidate against the photos and the request, plus code checks
(figure pixels identical, exact name). A failed check starts a regeneration with changed
inputs, capped per job (job.MAX_CONCEPT_FIXES).

text_read.description: The name as the model read it
text_read.title: Text Read

figure_identical.description: Share of the figure's opaque pixels copied unchanged into the product concept (1.0 = identical; loops keep their attachment band)
figure_identical.title: Figure Identical

ConceptCheck.title: ConceptCheck

ProductForm.description:
What the printed object is, set at intake and kept by every stage (FROM JACKSON).

flat: a relief charm, a height field of the front view with a flat back.
figure: a full 3D figure, never flattened later.
ProductForm.title: ProductForm

tweaks_exhausted.description: True once MAX_TWEAK_ROUNDS are used: pick only
tweaks_exhausted.title: Tweaks Exhausted
